# VisualToc

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a visual Table of Contents with dotted leaders and right-aligned page numbers, built from a list of heading identifiers that were registered during layout. Supports multi-page overflow via `IStatefulElement` so that very long tables of contents flow naturally across page boundaries.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new VisualToc()
```

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): Gets or sets the text color used for TOC entries.
- [`FontName`](#fontname): Gets or sets the font name used to render TOC entry text.
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Gets or sets the font size (in points) used to render TOC entry text.
- [`HeadingIdentifiers`](#headingidentifiers): Gets or sets the ordered list of TOC identifiers to render.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): Always `TOC`.

### `HeadingIdentifiers`


Gets or sets the ordered list of TOC identifiers to render. Each identifier must match the `TocIdentifier` of a rendered heading.

## Methods

- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders as many TOC entries as fit on the current page, advancing the cursor and returning `Overflow` when more entries remain for the next page.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Resets the render state so that rendering can restart from the first entry, for example before a second layout pass.

### `RenderStateful`

```csharp
RenderStatus RenderStateful(RenderContext ctx, float width)
```

Renders as many TOC entries as fit on the current page, advancing the cursor and returning `Overflow` when more entries remain for the next page.

- `ctx`: The current render context.
- `width`: The total available width including margins.

### `ResetState`

```csharp
void ResetState()
```

Resets the render state so that rendering can restart from the first entry, for example before a second layout pass.
